title: 第370章 塞外三个人的夜色第369章 尴尬局面
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
突然，一只萤火虫轻轻地落在齐煜的肩上，照得他的眼，明亮得就像天上的星。
这让樱落有些看呆了，竟忘了继续推开他。
“看来，你是一点儿也不关心本王了，也不知道本王是因为谁，才会变成这个样子……”
齐煜咋了咋舌，故意出了一副伤心的样子。
“那就让我回马车里，痛死、闷死吧……”
樱落心里咯噔一下，确实是这样没错！
齐煜是因为自己才会受重伤的，她又怎么能坐视不管呢？
只是在郊外躺一下，也不会有什么的吧……
毕竟人家真是伤员，于心不忍啊！
“等一下！”
樱落出声喊住了齐煜，随后小声说道：“……既然你身上有伤，那你就睡在这里吧。”
“好嘞！”
齐煜愉快地躺下了。
他就知道，这女人是个心善的。
所以，他自是有恃无恐咯！
不过这样一来，原本有些困意的樱落，此时却怎么也睡不着了。
稍微翻个身，齐煜的脸就近在咫尺，近到，一转头就会触碰到他的距离。
樱落深深的呼吸着，只觉得心跳如擂鼓，从来没有一刻像现在这般慌乱过。
不知道为什么？
每次近距离的接触齐煜，樱落都十分紧张。

以至于过了很久很久，她都不敢回头看他。
也不知道齐煜到底是醒着的，还是睡着的？
"笨女人，你在想什么呢?"
就在这时，耳畔突然传来了齐煜磁性的声音。
原来，他还没睡着?
樱落猛然回过头，十分担忧的看着他。
“你……不会是伤口痛得睡不着吧？让我看看。”
说着，樱落就要起身，去掀开他的衣襟。
虽然有随军的医女每日为他换药，可她还是不放心，不然怎么总是伤口疼呢？
自从见过了医仙凤倾雪的医术，别人的医术，似乎都入不了她的眼。
谁知，樱落的这一番举动，反而让齐煜尴尬起来，费力的躲闪着。
“没……没什么……本王只是觉得今晚塞外的夜色甚美，所以没睡，想要欣赏一番罢了。”
“哦，原来如此。”
樱落回过头，躺平，望着这头上的星空。
夜晚的营地，空旷静谧，满天繁星，郎朗星月悬于如墨的夜空中，的确美不胜收。
content_en:
Suddenly, a firefly landed gently on Qi Yu's shoulder, illuminating his eyes as brightly as the stars in the sky.
This made Yingluo a little stunned, and she actually forgot to push him away.
"It seems that you don't care about me at all, and you don't know who made me like this..."
Qi Yu clicked his tongue and deliberately looked sad.
"Then let me go back to the carriage and die of pain and suffocation..."
Yingluo's heart skipped a beat, it was indeed true!
Qi Yu was seriously injured because of herself, how could she just sit back and watch?
Just lying down in the countryside will be fine...
After all, he is really a wounded person, I can’t bear it!
"Wait a minute!"
Yingluo called out to Qi Yu, and then whispered: "...Since you are injured, you can sleep here."
"Okay!"
Qi Yu lay down happily.
He knew that this woman was kind-hearted.
Therefore, he is confident!
But in this way, Yingluo, who was originally a little sleepy, couldn't fall asleep at this time.
Turning over slightly, Qi Yu's face was very close at hand, so close that if he turned his head, he would touch him.
Yingluo took a deep breath and felt her heart beating like a drum. She had never been so panicked as she was now.
Don't know why?
Every time she comes into close contact with Qi Yu, Yingluo becomes very nervous.
So much later, she didn't dare to look back at him.
I don't know whether Qi Yu is awake or asleep?
"Stupid woman, what are you thinking about?"
At this moment, Qi Yu's magnetic voice suddenly came to his ears.
It turns out that he hasn't fallen asleep yet?
Ying Luo suddenly turned around and looked at him very worriedly.
"You...the wound hurts so much that you can't sleep, right? Let me take a look."
Saying that, Yingluo was about to stand up and lift up his clothes.
Although there was a female doctor who accompanied the army to change his dressing every day, she still felt uneasy, otherwise why would the wound always hurt?
Ever since she saw the medical skills of Medical Immortal Feng Qingxue, other people's medical skills seemed to be incomprehensible to her.
Unexpectedly, Yingluo's actions made Qi Yu embarrassed and he struggled to dodge.
"No...nothing...I just thought the night outside the Great Wall was very beautiful tonight, so I didn't sleep and wanted to enjoy it."
"Oh, that's it."
Yingluo turned around, lay down, and looked at the starry sky above her head.
The campground at night is empty and quiet, and the sky is full of stars. Lang Lang's stars and the moon hang in the inky night sky, which is really beautiful.
